data.value: Select an operation to configure its folders and options.

data.name: OrganizeDescription
data.value: Select the folder containing your photos and videos to organize them by year and month and build your chronological archive. You can separate videos from images or keep everything in the same folder.

data.name: DuplicatesDescription
data.value: Find photos and videos with identical content, review them, and send the selected files to the Recycle Bin.

data.name: ExtractDescription
data.value: Gather files in the root of a destination folder.

data.name: OrganizerDescription
data.value: Choose images, videos, or both. They will be moved into year and month folders using the earlier of their creation and modification dates.

data.name: SelectSourceToScan
data.value: Select a source folder to scan.

data.name: SubfolderDescription
data.value: Move all files found in subfolders to the destination root. Files already at the source root are left unchanged. If a name conflicts, the incoming file gets an incremental suffix, even when its content is identical.

data.name: SelectSourceToSearchSubfolders
data.value: Select a source folder to find files in its subfolders.
